# biznetgio_neolite_os_list (Data Source)

Daftar OS yang tersedia untuk product NEO Lite (pakai buat isi `select_os` di `biznetgio_neolite_vm`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "biznetgio_neolite_products" "all" {}

data "biznetgio_neolite_os_list" "this" {
  product_id = data.biznetgio_neolite_products.all.products[0].product_id
}

output "os_names" {
  value = [for os in data.biznetgio_neolite_os_list.this.oss : os.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `product_id` (Number) Product id NEO Lite.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source id statis.
- `oss` (Attributes List) Daftar OS. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oss))

<a id="nestedatt--oss"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oss`

Read-Only:

- `maxcpu` (Number) CPU maksimal.
- `maxmem` (Number) Memory maksimal (MB).
- `name` (String) Nama OS — isi buat `select_os`.
- `node` (String) Node Proxmox.
- `vmid` (Number) Id OS template.
